messages:
anya: Pushed HF->Redwood bringup for metax-7b-qa. generation_config.json mapping looks off: repetition_penalty seems ignored inside chat template runs. Anyone seen this? It was fine on the raw HF text-generation test but chat mode repeats more.

sam: hmm, possible tokenizer mismatch. Does the model's tokenizer.json declare extra special tokens? I saw a case where HF had two assistant tokens and Redwood's chat preprocessor collapsed them -> shift in token ids.

michael: can you paste generation_config.json + the chat template you used?

anya: sure:
```json
{
  "temperature": 0.7,
  "top_p": 0.9,
  "top_k": 50,
  "repetition_penalty": 1.2,
  "do_sample": true
}
```
chat template:
```
[System]: You are an assistant.
[User]: {user}
[Assistant]:
```

sam: ok. Redwood maps HF genconfig -> runtime params but for chat we currently strip "repetition_penalty" for models flagged as "chat_format": true. Bug from when we prevented RP double-counting with turn-level penalties. @dru filed a note about this last month :facepalm:

dru: yep I remember. PR #1243 added that guard. It assumed "assistant" special token present. If tokenizer has extra special tokens (e.g. "<|assistant_2|>"), our detection rule fails and the runtime path falls back to text-gen defaults which drop RP. I'll link the PR.

anya: that matches our evals — small A/B on 2k prompts: with explicit RP applied in runtime we get 14% fewer repetition alerts and -0.04 perplexity. Without it we saw stubborn repeated phrases.

michael: workaround: set a route-level override in Redwood Console to force repetition_penalty via policy until we fix detection. Example curl:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/routes/override \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -d '{"route":"/chat/metax","overrides":{"repetition_penalty":1.2}}'
```

dru: I'll open a hotfix to make the special-token detection robust to multiple assistant tokens and ensure genconfig mapping respects explicit repetition_penalty for chat. Also will add a unit test with tokenizers that include extra special tokens.

ci-bot: deploy started for fix/rgp-allow-multi-assistant-tokens (CI 5721)

anya: thanks! I'll re-run quantized evals once the fix is in. FYI our 4-bit quant runs amplified the repetition by ~5% vs fp16 — probably due to softer logits.

sam: noted. can someone add a quick note to the onboarding checklist: verify special tokens + genconfig mapping when bringing HF chat models.

michael: added to checklist (doc link) :thumbsup:
